kernel: kEstimateQuantiles<float> (csrc/kernels.cu); the half instantiation has the same code but is not launched

sites.operation: st.shared (SASS: STS [R0.X4], R19 at 0x2280, inside the loop 'for(int j = threadIdx.x; j < BLOCK_ESTIMATE; j+=blockDim.x)' at L654, executed by all 512 threads over j = tid, tid+512, ..., tid+3584)
st.shared (SASS: STS [R3.X4], R14 at 0x2390, executed only by threads with threadIdx.x < 256)

thread_pair_example: driver: kEstimateQuantiles<float><<<4, 512>>>, n = 16384, offset = 1/512, valid_items = 4096, block 0 (any block): thread 32 (warp 1) writes smem_qidx[520] = 32 at L661 (local_idx = round((1 + 2*32) * 7.998046875) = 520) while thread 8 (warp 0) clears smem_qidx[8 + 512 = 520] = -1 at L655 (second trip of its clear loop). Both writes lie between the barrier at L653 (after SortBlockedToStriped) and the barrier at L664, with nothing in between; a late clear overwrites the freshly scattered index (WAW), and that quantile's contribution is then dropped from the atomicAdd accumulation at L669. smem_qidx[4096] is a member of a union aliased with the CUB BlockLoad/BlockRadixSort temp storage.
class_reason: Both accesses are plain stores to a plain __shared__ int array (union member smem_qidx): ordinary STS, no volatile, no atomic, no .STRONG token; the two writing threads are in different warps and nothing orders them (the barrier at L664 comes after both), so this is a data race (DR), write-after-write.
buggy_expected: The pair (L655 clear store vs L661 scatter store on the same smem_qidx slot, cross-warp WAW in kEstimateQuantiles) is reported as DR.

fixed.reason: The fix adds one __syncthreads() between the clear loop and the scatter (fixed file L657, SASS BAR.SYNC.DEFER_BLOCKING at 0x22d0); the scatter store moves to L663 (STS at 0x23a0). All 512 threads reach the barrier (it is outside the 'if(threadIdx.x < 256)' block; the loop body is entered by every thread of the block, and the 'continue' for half blocks at L633 is uniform per block, n = 16384 gives only full blocks).

sass_notes: sm_89, nvdisasm -g of the driver built with -lineinfo (the lineinfo check of the R2 route is SAME: targets/lit-arrayfire-1/lineinfo.check). Buggy kEstimateQuantiles<float>: BAR.SYNC at kernels.cu:653 (0x2090), STS [R0.X4] at L655 (0x2280, loop), STS [R3.X4] at L661 (0x2390), BAR.SYNC at L664 (0x23b0), LDS [R0.X4] at L668 (0x23e0). Fixed: BAR.SYNC at L657 (0x22d0) between STS L655 (0x2280) and STS L663 (0x23a0). Both stores are plain STS, no strong token. WARPSYNC 0xffffffff is emitted at L639 (0x05e0, before the load / sort, outside this pair); none between the clear and the scatter. The record's thread numbers (thread 32 / thread 8 / slot 520) were re-derived: q_interval = (1 - 2/512)/255 = 1/256, local_idx(t) = round((1 + 2t) * 4095 / 512), t = 32 gives 519.87 -> 520.
derived_from: verify.accesses + verify.thread_pair of targets.jsonl, re-checked against csrc/kernels.cu@344e851 (and @5b28fd3 for the fixed lines) on 2026-10-20; lines and SASS offsets taken from the file as compiled (R2 harness file name = repo path).
open_questions: Native manifestation: 30 runs of each variant on sm_75 (smoke build) gave identical output (0 of 256 quantiles off), so the lost-quantile effect was not observed natively; the detection relies on the detector's analysis of the pair.

Route: the project's own R1 build fails on CUDA 13.4 at configure (CMakeLists.txt:82 'CUDA Version > 12 is not supported'); the build here is R2 (verbatim csrc/kernels.cu plus the cub::Max / cub::Sum stand-ins, which CCCL 3 removed). The SASS is therefore from CUDA 13.4 / CCCL 3 sorting code, not from the CUDA 12 build the project would produce.

review.notes: R2 harness: every copied kernel file under r2/buggy and r2/fixed is byte-identical (cmp) to git show <buggy_commit>:<path> / <fix_commit>:<path>; git diff buggy..fix of those files is exactly the fix hunk described in fixed.reason.
